binary.name: cua-driver-b01-f5c991e59
binary.rule: same binary in both arms; experiment knobs set only in the composed arm; trace on in both arms

provider.name: TypeSafe
provider.path: jev-use choose_live_for_task (request builder validated dry for toggle/modal in B-01 raw/live-request-validation.json)

arms.baseline: K0n shape: feedback default ON, no guarded completion, focus settle unset (100 ms), completion poll 100 ms, library MCP schema validation

composed.feedback: fast glide: set_agent_cursor_motion {glide_duration_ms:1, dwell_after_click_ms:0}, cursor enabled
composed.completion_poll_rationale: H_P found no material component with library validation, but with compiled validators the fill completion poll is entered in 100% of K5 trials (the action returns before the submit lands), so the composed arm keeps the cost-free 10 ms poll
composed.mcp_client_validation: compiled once per schema at tools/list (caller-side), all classes
composed.guarded_completion: PR 4316 --guarded-completion on fill only (binds only FIXTURE_TASK_ID; does not apply to toggle/modal at this source)
composed.compiled_replay: slot reserved; enabled only if R2-07 is KEEP, measured over all invocations incl. fallback and compile/admission cost

design.order: AB/BA alternating per pair, classes interleaved per round
design.lock: EXCLUSIVE quiet-lane lock; loadavg per trial; every trial and failure kept

metrics.T: first semantic_v2 send -> runner's first oracle-confirmed read (T_runner, B-01 definition); T_oracle (2 ms harness re-read) also reported
metrics.S: median T_baseline / median T_composed per class with seeded paired bootstrap CI (10000, seed fixed in the final PREREG)
metrics.floor_ratio: T_composed / T_irreducible, T_irreducible = sum of IRREDUCIBLE components from the decomposition

gates.validity: >= 95% verified per arm per class, identical verified outcomes
gates.E3: >= 30 AB/BA pairs per browser class with identical verified outcomes

provider_budget.stop_rule: stop the lane when reached requests exceed the attempt cap or the loop budget in STATE.json
